name: Ashley Schaeffers Gear and Clothing
teaser: BEAR and USEC Gear and Clothing
description_html:
Well its been over 2 years and thanks to Turbodestroyer’s Couturier mod I’ve been able to bring my gear and clothing mods back to life. I’ve been working hard to bring this back (started over 2 months ago) again special shoutout to turbodestroyer, my mod is based on his Couturier mod. I wasn’t yet completed with all my retextures and everything I had planned, but with the forge shutting down in a few days I wanted to get this out to those that appreciated them back in the day.

I have created the Ashley Schaeffer trader, he works in US dollars.

Clothing for USEC and BEAR side will work with bots. As well as the equipment.

There is a config file in the mod that lists: -sellGearOnFlea (you can sell the gear on flea market) -allGearAvailableOnFlea (if you want the gear available on flea) -botsUseGear (whether bots use the gear) -traderEnabled (if you want the Ashley Schaeffer trader enabled) -pmcsUseFactionedGearOnly (USEC will only use USEC gear/ BEAR will only use BEAR Gear) -botsUseClothing (bots will use their factions clothing) -unlockOthersFactionsClothing (USECs can buy Bear clothing) -sellClothingOnRagman (default is set to false, but ragman will sell the clothing if you don’t want the Ashley Schaeffer trader enabled)

Like I mentioned at the top of this post I wanted to get this out with the forge shutting down. I do plan on finishing it and where ever we move to next it will be available. The BEAR and USEC clothing in the mod was mostly completed (still want to add some of the battlepass Black division stuff for USEC) as for the gear I was in the process of retexturing alot of the items to make them look better when I got the notification the forge was shutting down. For now I have quite a bit of items for BEAR within the mod but sadly nothing for USEC only clothing, and one 2 day assault pack in multicam.
